headline: GO084 now has a fail-closed volatile semantic-state start guard on self-integration main, validated against the real host without mutating the VM lifecycle
state: self-integration main is 73284879a50d655e64b9dde6f4491e0eb4cc4a6f and contains werkzeug/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh plus a 10-case self-test. The guard scans only the old rootfs-run semantic state trees under root/.local/share/agentzero and root/.local/share/frank, identifies SQLite by magic bytes, excludes cache scope, permits schema-only databases, and fails closed with rc=255 on populated semantic state, unreadable SQLite candidates, missing required tools, or incompletely traversable trees. The real andreas-maco read-only discriminator returned rc=255 and named four populated semantic stores: consciousness.db, the clone-local agentzero/unified.db, amygdala.db, and world_experience.db. The live checkout was not modified by the discriminator. This proves the guard detects the present loss condition. It does NOT prove entityos-vm.service currently invokes the guard before its destructive rootfs-run recreation; the observed live unit does not contain this guard, so lifecycle wiring remains open.
zero_credit: no entityos-vm.service wiring installed or proven
next: Keep the destructive VM start fail-closed in design: the next executable product boundary is to wire this exact accepted guard into the admitted VM lifecycle before the rootfs-run rm -rf, then perform the already-specified SQLite backup/bind/recreate/readback migration only under current effect/owner authority. Do not restart the VM merely to test the guard while four semantic stores remain volatile.
